cities.name: Brussels
cities.local_food_tip: Belgian waffles, fries (frites), chocolate, moules‑frites, local beers — enjoy rich flavors in cosy cafés and brasseries. 🧇🍟🍫🍺
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🕰️ Visit Grand Place, Town Hall and historic old‑town streets → ☕ Coffee with waffle or pastry in a local café.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Explore museums (comics, art, history) or walk through European quarter → 🍽️ Lunch: local Belgian dishes or snacks.

Sunset: 🌇 Mont des Arts viewpoint or rooftop bar for panoramic city views.

Night: 🌃 Dinner with Belgian cuisine, then visit lively neighbourhoods for street‑food, live music or relax in old‑town pubs.

ideas: 🌸 Parks and squares bloom — ideal for strolls and street‑art tours.
🎨 Open‑air markets, art fairs and cultural events begin.
☕ Outdoor cafés open up, perfect for relaxed meals and people‑watching.
🌞 Extended daylight — more time for sightseeing and exploring city life.
🍨 Ice‑cream, street‑food and cafés on every corner.
🎶 Open‑air concerts, festivals and night bazaars in central squares.
🍂 Tree‑lined streets turn warm-toned — great for photos and walks.
🥘 Warm meals and hearty Belgian dishes as weather cools.
🏛️ Museums and indoor visits ideal for unpredictable rain or chilly days.
🎄 Christmas markets, festive lights and warm drinks in old‑town.
🔥 Hot chocolate, waffles or Belgian beer in cosy pubs after sightseeing.
🕌 Indoor visits — museums, galleries, historic interiors — if cold outside.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use metro, trams and buses — Brussels has good public transport for city travel.
🚶 Many sights are walkable within central zones — ideal for pedestrian tours.
🎟️ Tourist pass or day‑ticket saves money if planning many visits in a day.
🚲 Bikes or scooters help for short rides especially around city center.

city_events.name: Winter Holiday Market & Lights
city_events.description: 🎄 Christmas market, festive decorations and cosy winter ambience in historic streets.

cities.name: Antwerp
cities.local_food_tip: Belgian beers, hearty stews, local seafood and typical Flemish dishes — perfect after a walk along the river or old‑town streets. 🍲🍺🐟
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🚶 Stroll along riverfront, old port, historical warehouses and harbour views → ☕ Breakfast at a café by the river.

Afternoon: 🏰 Visit Cathedral of Our Lady, historic center and diamond‑district boutiques → 🍽️ Lunch with local specialties.

Sunset: 🌇 View from hills or high‑points over river + city — ideal for photos and sunset atmosphere.

Night: 🌃 Try local beers and enjoy nightlife — old town pubs, street food or riverside walk under lights.

spring.event: Spring by the River & City Buzz
ideas: 🌿 Riverside paths bloom, perfect for walks and cycling.
🎨 Street‑art, galleries and cultural flair as city wakes up.
☕ Outdoor terraces open — relaxed cafés and fresh air.
🌞 Boat rides or walks along river, outdoor cafés by water.
🍧 Ice‑cream, street‑food and relaxed summer evenings in town.
🎶 Festivals, concerts or events near port or historic zones.
🍁 City architecture framed by autumn leaves — great for photos.
🥘 Comfort food, hearty meals and cosy pubs for chilly afternoons.
🏛️ Museums and indoor heritage tours ideal for rainy times.
❄️ Crisp weather, river mists — atmospheric walks by Scheldt.
🔥 Warm meals, Belgian beer and cosy indoor vibes in old‑town.
🖼️ Indoor galleries, cathedrals and historical visits for cold days.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Trains, trams and buses connect main city and suburbs — good for city travel.
🚶 Historic centre and riverfront are walkable — ideal for sightseeing on foot.
🚲 Bike paths along river make cycling pleasant and scenic.
🎫 Consider day‑ticket if planning many activities in a single day.

city_events.name: Antwerp Summer River Nights
city_events.description: 🎶 Waterfront concerts, river‑walk nights and city festivals by the port.

cities.name: Boom
cities.local_food_tip: Festival food trucks, Belgian fries, waffles, fast food and street snacks — quick energy meals during long event days. 🍟🧇

Afternoon: 🎧 Entry into festival grounds, enjoy international DJs and massive stages, cultural villages and themed areas → 🍔 Food truck lunch and drinks.

Sunset: 🌅 Watch main stage performances under lights and sunset sky — peak energy time.

Night: 🌃 Night shows, lasers, firework displays and DJ performances until late hours — world‑class festival experience.

ideas: 🎶 Smaller music events and club nights in nearby cities.
🚶 Relaxed countryside walks before festival season starts.
☕ Local cafés and gathering spots fill up with early visitors.

🌍 People from 200+ countries gather in one place.
🎆 Fireworks, fantasy‑style stages and world‑class music acts.
🍂 Quiet town life after summer crowds leave.
🏞️ Local nature walks near river and countryside.
☕ Enjoy chilled cafés after the busy summer.
🔥 Small indoor music nights and winter community events.
☕ Cozy cafés and quiet town atmosphere.
🧤 Short peaceful visits without tourist crowds.

🚌 Special event transport during large festivals like Tomorrowland.
🚕 Ride‑share services widely used during events.

city_events.name: Tomorrowland Festival
city_events.description: 🎧 One of the largest electronic music festivals in the world — music, fantasy stages and global culture combined.

cities.name: Ostend
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh seafood, shrimp dishes, fish specialties, coastal dishes — enjoy sea‑flavours by the North Sea. 🐠🍷

Afternoon: 🐚 Visit maritime museums or historic ship‑museum, stroll harbour or try coastal activities → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or local coastal meal.

Sunset: 🌇 Beach walk at golden hour, sea breeze and views over the North Sea.

Night: 🌃 Dinner with sea‑view, nightlife near the coast — relaxed bars, seafood restaurants or seaside stroll under stars.

🚶 Promenade strolls along coast or harbour paths.
🥘 Seafood lunch in a coastal tavern with ocean atmosphere.
🏖️ Sun, sea, swimming or beach walks — enjoy summer at the coast.
🍨 Ice‑cream, seaside snacks, relaxed beach vibe and coastal evenings.
🎉 Beach events, festivals or summer nightlife by the sea.
🌊 Fresher sea breeze, calm waves — ideal for peaceful coastal walks.
🔥 Warm seafood dinners, hearty meals after chilly days.
📷 Moody sea views for photos and quiet reflection near water.
❄️ Stormy seas, fresh sea air and dramatic coastline — atmospheric and wild.
🔥 Hot meals, cozy restaurants and warm drinks after cold seaside strolls.
🏛️ Museums and indoor maritime heritage — good alternatives on cold or windy days.

city_events.name: Ostend Coastal Summer Nights

cities.name: Knokke‑Heist

Afternoon: 🚶 Explore town boutiques and art galleries, visit nearby coastal nature reserve for bird‑watching or dune walks → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or light coastal meal.

Sunset: 🌇 Promenade or dune viewpoint for sunset views over sea — peaceful, calm and scenic.

Night: 🌙 Dinner in upscale seaside restaurant, relaxed coastal nightlife or quiet stroll along beach under stars.

ideas: 🌿 Coastal nature wakes — fresh air, blooming flora and peaceful walks on sand dunes.
☀️ Mild weather — nice for long beach walks or nature hikes near coast.
🎨 Local art exhibitions and cultural events in town galleries or seaside venues.
🏖️ Beach time, sun, sea, and relaxed coastal rhythm.
🍧 Ice‑cream, seafood dinners and elegant seaside dining under summer sky.
🌙 Evening strolls on promenade, seaside nightlife and calm coastal ambience.
🍂 Dunes and beaches with autumn light — scenic and tranquil for walks.
🔥 Hearty seafood dinners or warm meals by the sea after day out.
📸 Coastal photos with soft light and empty beaches — ideal for peaceful getaway.

winter.event: Winter Coast Calm & Cozy Indoor Moments
ideas: 🌬️ Windy sea, empty coastline — calm, moody and atmospheric seaside walks.
🔥 Warm seafood, hot drinks, cosy indoor dining by the sea.
🎨 Indoor galleries, small museums or town cafes — comfortable coastal vibe in cold season.
